cards.subject: Half-length, the vigorous pope of the early 1980s: white cassock with the short white shoulder cape (pellegrina), white zucchetto, a gold pectoral cross on a cord; his right hand raised in blessing, his left holding the tall silver papal staff topped by a crucifix of the bent, suffering Christ (the Scorzelli ferula). Background: Kraków seen across the Vistula, Wawel Hill with the cathedral and castle, and the Tatra mountains faint on the horizon.
cards.face: A sturdy, broad-shouldered, athletic man of about sixty, clean-shaven, with a broad Slavic face, high cheekbones and a strong square jaw, light grey-blue eyes, fair, greying ash-blond hair showing at the temples under the zucchetto, and a warm, open half-smile; not heavy or fleshy.
cards.basis: Photographs from his first decade as pope (1979 Poland, 1991) and the record of an athlete and mountaineer elected at 58; the Scorzelli ferula he carried everywhere. Kept lean and fair to stand apart from Leo's heavy, dark-eyed pope.

cards.subject: Half-length: white cassock, red velvet mozzetta, a red stole embroidered in gold with figures of saints, and on his head the red velvet camauro trimmed with white ermine, which he revived; a gold pectoral cross, a rosary in one hand and the other resting on an open Gospel book. Background: his birthplace, Sotto il Monte in the hills of Bergamo, with a village church tower, farmhouses and the foothills of the Alps.
cards.face: A stout, heavy-set man of about eighty, clean-shaven, with a large round face, full cheeks and a double chin, a broad, prominent nose, small twinkling dark-brown eyes creased with laughter lines, and a broad, kindly smile.
cards.basis: His official photographs as pope (1958–63): a round, smiling, heavy-set old man with a large nose, in red mozzetta and embroidered stole; the camauro distinguishes him from the other popes.

cards.subject: Half-length: white cassock and white zucchetto, a red velvet mozzetta edged with white ermine, a red stole embroidered with figures of the apostles, a simple gold pectoral cross; he holds a closed Gospel book against his chest with both hands, head slightly inclined. Background: his 1964 pilgrimage to the Holy Land, the Sea of Galilee with the rounded dome of Mount Tabor rising from the plain.
cards.face: A slender, ascetic man of about seventy, clean-shaven, with a long, narrow face, a high bald forehead and close dark-grey hair at the temples under the zucchetto, a pronounced aquiline nose, deep-set clear blue eyes under strong dark brows, thin lips and a grave, gentle, thoughtful expression.
cards.basis: The 1969 official portrait and other photographs: a thin, long-faced pope with an aquiline nose and deep-set light eyes, in ermine-trimmed mozzetta and apostle stole. He was the first pope to fly and to visit the Holy Land (1964).

cards.subject: Half-length: a peasant girl of the Roman countryside in a plain white blouse with rolled sleeves, a dark skirt and a white apron, holding a bunch of white lilies against her breast and a martyr's palm; a small halo of light, no wound shown. Background: the flat farmland of the Pontine marshes at Le Ferriere near Nettuno, the old farmhouse La Cascina Antica with its outside stair, and a line of the sea on the horizon.
cards.face: A girl of eleven, visibly a child, with a round, soft face, a lightly sun-warmed complexion, long, wavy chestnut-brown hair parted in the middle and loosely tied back, large dark-brown eyes and a serene, trusting gaze; no crown, no veil.
cards.basis: The only photograph of her (1902, among the farm's poultry in a white blouse and apron) and the traditional portrait with long wavy chestnut hair; Wikipedia gives her attributes as lily, farmer's clothing and palm. She died at eleven.

cards.subject: Half-length: the black habit of the Canossian Daughters of Charity with the round black bonnet gathered in soft ruffles and tied under the chin, a white collar band, and on her breast the Canossian medal of Our Lady of Sorrows on a cord; her hands folded over a small crucifix; a broken iron chain lying at the lower edge of the window. Background: Schio in the Veneto, the Canossian convent with its church, and the green Pre-Alps behind the town.
cards.face: A Sudanese woman of about fifty with deep dark-brown skin, a round, full face, a broad nose and full lips, large, gentle dark eyes and a warm, open smile; no marks on the face.
cards.basis: Her photographs (c. 1910 and the colour portrait) in the Canossian habit and ruffled bonnet with the Sorrowful Mother medal; Schio remembered her 'ever-present smile', and called her 'Madre Moretta'. The broken chain is the usual modern emblem of the slave set free.

cards.subject: Half-length: the old habit of a Dominican lay brother, a white tunic under a black scapular and black hooded cape, a long rosary at the belt; a straw broom in one hand and a small crucifix in the other; at his feet a dog, a cat and a mouse eating peacefully from one bowl, kept small inside the arched window. Background: colonial Lima, the Dominican convent of the Holy Rosary (Santo Domingo) with its tall tower, under a pale coastal sky.
cards.face: A slender Afro-Peruvian man of about forty-five with warm medium-brown skin, close-cropped black hair tightly curled, clean-shaven, a broad nose and full lips, heavy-lidded dark eyes lowered in humility, and a gentle, quiet expression.
cards.basis: The 17th-century portrait in Lima thought to be from his lifetime or just after (clean-shaven, close dark hair), the 2016 facial reconstruction from his skull, and his parentage (a Spanish father and a freed mother of African and native descent). Broom and the dog, cat and mouse are his standard attributes.

cards.subject: Half-length: a Nahua man in a plain white cotton tunic, with a coarse cream-coloured maguey-fibre tilma knotted at his right shoulder; with both hands he holds the tilma open in front of him, and on it is the image of Our Lady of Guadalupe (the rose-pink robe, blue-green mantle with gold stars, sunburst and crescent), while red and pink Castilian roses spill from its folds. Background: the rocky hill of Tepeyac at a December dawn, with nopal cactus and scrub, and the lake and valley of Mexico beyond.
cards.face: A Nahua man of about fifty-seven with a broad, high-cheekboned indigenous face, warm brown skin, straight black hair cut in a thick fringe across the forehead and falling straight to the jaw, CLEAN-SHAVEN (no beard, no moustache), dark gentle eyes lowered in humble wonder. He must not resemble Christ.
cards.basis: The colonial 'true portraits' (Cabrera's Fiel retrato, the Verdadero retrato) show him with long straight black hair, a thin moustache and sparse beard, in a white tilma; he was born in 1474 and was 57 in 1531. Attributes: the tilma with the image, and the roses of Tepeyac.

cards.subject: Half-length: the black habit of the Lebanese Maronite Order with its black hood (cowl) drawn forward over the head down to the brows, a leather belt, a knotted prayer rope over his hands, which are crossed on a small wooden crucifix held to his breast. Background: the hermitage of Saints Peter and Paul on its hilltop above the monastery of Saint Maron at Annaya, Mount Lebanon, with terraced slopes, oaks and pines, in soft evening light.
cards.face: A lean old monk of about seventy with a long, narrow face and high cheekbones, a straight, fine nose, a long, full white beard falling to the chest and a white moustache, heavy white brows, and eyes lowered and almost closed in recollection; the hood shadows the forehead, no hair visible.
cards.basis: No picture was taken in life; his standard image comes from the 1950 photograph at Annaya in which the old monks recognised him: a long white beard, black hood and downcast eyes. He died in 1898 at seventy; Wikipedia gives habit and prayer rope as his attributes.

cards.subject: Half-length: a priest in a plain black cassock with a white Roman collar, a small crucifix in one hand and a rosary in the other, turned three-quarters toward the viewer. Background: Madrid, where he founded Opus Dei in 1928: low brick houses and a church dome under a clear Castilian sky, with people at their daily work in the street below, kept small.
cards.face: A robust, clean-shaven priest of about sixty-five with a broad, round face and full cheeks, dark hair greying at the temples, combed straight back from a high forehead, dark eyes behind heavy dark-rimmed rectangular spectacles, and a wide, cheerful smile.
cards.basis: His photographs of the 1960s–70s and the official Opus Dei prayer card: a round, smiling face, dark hair combed back and dark-rimmed glasses, in a black cassock. The glasses are rectangular and dark to keep him apart from Kolbe's round wire spectacles.

cards.subject: Half-length: a royal princess in a deep green gown with gold embroidery and a crimson mantle lined with ermine, an open gold crown set with pearls; she holds an open book in one hand and a martyr's palm in the other; beside her, the spiked wheel lies broken in two, its rim shattered; a sword, if shown, rests point-down and sheathed. Background: the harbour of Alexandria with the Pharos lighthouse and white colonnades by the sea.
cards.face: A young noblewoman of eighteen with a fine oval face, fair olive skin, a straight classical nose, dark chestnut hair braided and coiled up beneath the crown with a few loose strands, large dark-brown eyes and a clear, intelligent, composed gaze.
cards.basis: The Golden Legend makes her a king's daughter, 'fair of visage', learned in the liberal arts, eighteen when she disputed in Alexandria, and says the wheels were broken at her prayer; crown, wheel, palm, book and sword are her standard attributes. The dark chestnut hair follows Caravaggio and keeps her apart from Agnes, Lucy and Philomena.
